name: To The Hinterlands
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
As I mentioned earlier, I attempted to scout the temple on my own from the air. Well, I wasn't exactly alone.

I traveled to the renowned gryphon aviary at Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands. There I enlisted the aid of one of their finest pilots. The pilot fell off his mount, down into the swamp...

In my old age the poor fellow's name eludes me. The master of the aviary would remember, no doubt.

Journey there and seek out Falstad Wildhammer.

We need to find out what happened to that pilot.
narrative.objectives: Speak with High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What do you want, laddy? Can't you see I've got problems to take care of here? Who has time to stand around yapping with some friend chatterbox?

There are trolls coming out of the woodwork! Make it snappy.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 43 to 50, 21,500 XP in all.

quests.name: In Search of The Temple
quests.objectiveText: Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind wants you to search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

quests.name: To The Hinterlands
quests.objectiveText: Speak with High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Gryphon Master Talonaxe
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe inside the Aerie Peak Aviary.

quests.name: Rhapsody Shindigger
quests.objectiveText: Seek out Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands.

quests.name: Rhapsody's Kalimdor Kocktail
quests.objectiveText: Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands wants you to bring him 3 Roc Gizzards, 3 Groddoc Livers and 3 Ironfur Livers.

quests.name: Rhapsody's Tale
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.

quests.name: Into The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
quests.objectiveText: Gather 10 Atal'ai Tablets for Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
